list.name: symbol
list.label: Ativo sintetico
list.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT DISTINCT a.name AS __text, v.symbol AS __value FROM valid v JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=v.symbol ORDER BY a.name

list.name: period
list.label: Periodo
list.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT CASE v.period_seconds WHEN 300 THEN 'M5' WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' ELSE 'H1' END AS __text, v.period_seconds::text AS __value FROM valid v WHERE v.symbol='${symbol}' ORDER BY v.period_seconds

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT s.* FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.symbol='${symbol}' AND s.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE side WHEN 'CALL' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS value FROM latest s JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=s.symbol AND m.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version WHERE side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND reason='ok' AND probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer

WITH latest AS (SELECT s.* FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.symbol='${symbol}' AND s.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT round((probability * 100)::numeric,1) AS value FROM latest s JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=s.symbol AND m.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version WHERE side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND reason='ok' AND probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer

WITH latest AS (SELECT s.* FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.symbol='${symbol}' AND s.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT extract(epoch from now())::bigint - candle_epoch AS value FROM latest s JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=s.symbol AND m.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version WHERE side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND reason='ok' AND probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(correct::integer),1) AS value FROM indicator_signals WHERE symbol = '${symbol}' AND period_seconds = NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND correct IS NOT NULL AND model_version IN (SELECT model_version FROM indicator_model_versions WHERE symbol='${symbol}' AND period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) AND $__unixEpochFilter(candle_epoch) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM indicator_symbols a JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.side,x.reason,x.probability,x.candle_epoch,x.model_version FROM indicator_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY x.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=a.symbol AND m.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND m.model_version=latest.model_version WHERE a.symbol='${symbol}' AND a.active AND latest.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND latest.reason='ok' AND latest.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < latest.candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer)

WITH latest AS (SELECT s.* FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.symbol='${symbol}' AND s.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 'APROVADO' AS value FROM latest s JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=s.symbol AND m.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version WHERE side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND reason='ok' AND probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer

WITH latest AS (SELECT s.* FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.symbol='${symbol}' AND s.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT to_timestamp(o.observed_at) AS observado_em, o.spot AS preco_agora, round(o.delta::numeric,5) AS variacao_desde_fechamento, o.interim_side AS direcao_provisoria, CASE WHEN o.interim_side='EMPATE' THEN 'NEUTRO' WHEN o.interim_side=s.side THEN 'A FAVOR' ELSE 'CONTRA' END AS situacao, s.side AS previsao_fechamento, 'APROVADO' AS validacao, to_timestamp(s.candle_epoch + 2 * s.period_seconds) AS horizonte_fim FROM latest s JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=s.symbol AND m.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version JOIN indicator_live o ON o.symbol=s.symbol AND o.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND o.signal_epoch=s.candle_epoch WHERE s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.reason='ok' AND s.probability IS NOT NULL AND o.observed_at >= extract(epoch from now()) - 120 AND extract(epoch from now()) < s.candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer

SELECT to_timestamp(candle_epoch + NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) AS time, close AS value FROM indicator_signals WHERE symbol = '${symbol}' AND period_seconds = NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND $__unixEpochFilter(candle_epoch) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM indicator_symbols a JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.side,x.reason,x.probability,x.candle_epoch,x.model_version FROM indicator_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY x.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=a.symbol AND m.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND m.model_version=latest.model_version WHERE a.symbol='${symbol}' AND a.active AND latest.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND latest.reason='ok' AND latest.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < latest.candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) ORDER BY candle_epoch

SELECT to_timestamp(candle_epoch + NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) AS vela_fechada, to_timestamp(candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) AS horizonte_fim, side AS sinal, round((probability * 100)::numeric,1) AS prob_call_pct, reason AS estado, model_version AS modelo, observed_side AS direcao_observada, correct AS acertou FROM indicator_signals WHERE symbol = '${symbol}' AND period_seconds = NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND reason='ok' AND model_version IN (SELECT model_version FROM indicator_model_versions WHERE symbol='${symbol}' AND period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) AND $__unixEpochFilter(candle_epoch) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM indicator_symbols a JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.side,x.reason,x.probability,x.candle_epoch,x.model_version FROM indicator_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer ORDER BY x.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=a.symbol AND m.period_seconds=NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer AND m.model_version=latest.model_version WHERE a.symbol='${symbol}' AND a.active AND latest.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND latest.reason='ok' AND latest.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < latest.candle_epoch + 2 * NULLIF('${period:raw}','')::integer) ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 500
